thread:
sam: heads-up — nightly eval picked up a sharp regression on our ptq canary (model://redwood/gptx-7b-ptq-v3). rouge/QA F1 dropped ~7 points and hallucination rate spiked on the KBQA suite.

anita: ack. is this the 8-bit packed-kv build we promoted yesterday?

sam: yes — ptq recipe v3 with kv_pack=true and bias_correction toggled. small canary (10% traffic) promoted to staging yesterday.

kevin: can you paste the quant config we used?

sam: pasted below — it's the same as the canary artifact metadata:
```yaml
quant:
  method: ptq
  bitwidth: 8
  calibrate: per-channel
  bias_correction: true
  kv_pack: true
  dynamic_range_clip: 0.995
  fudge_scale: 1.02
```

zia: quick hypothesis: bias_correction + kv_pack interaction may be shifting logits for rare tokens, causing hallucinations on KBQA prompts. we've seen similar in packed-kv experiments before.

sylvia: do we have sample generations? any systematic token-level differences?

sam: yes — collecting 50 failing examples and diffing logits now. early look: top-1 token probabilities diverge from fp32 after step 12 in decoding for long-context prompts. also KV cache mismatch for prompt fragments with lots of numbers.

ci-bot: nightly-eval report uploaded: https://ci/reports/nightly/2445556667 (summary attached). Failing suites: kbqa-coverage, long-context-summary, structured-output.

anita: mitigation suggestion: immediate rollback of canary to previous ptq-v2 (or disable kv_pack) until we triage. also add a gating rule to block promotion if KBQA hallucination delta > 3% over baseline.

kevin: agreed. propose these actions (short):
- rollback canary to ptq-v2  — action by infra (deploy-bot)
- run targeted A/B on the 1k KBQA promptset with v2 vs v3 (deterministic seed) — action eng-ml
- instrument per-token KL and top-k mismatch metrics in nightly job — action eng-ml
- add gating: require KBQA F1 within 1.5 pts of baseline for 24h before promote — action product + eng-ml

sam: I'm going to run a micro-experiment toggling bias_correction=false while keeping kv_pack to see which knob is causal. will post results in ~45m.

deploy-bot: rolling back model://redwood/gptx-7b-ptq-v3 -> model://redwood/gptx-7b-ptq-v2 in staging (canary traffic will be set to 0%). ETA 3m. :gear:

zia: once rollback is confirmed, let's schedule an isolated PTQ run where we vary only bias_correction and kv_pack (2x2 matrix) and capture both generation metrics + token-level KL across the KBQA prompts. that should pinpoint interaction effects.

anita: also add a temporary eval gating script in the deploy pipeline that fails the promotion job if any of these hold: hallucination_rate_delta > 2% OR kbqa_f1_drop > 3 OR median_topk_divergence > 0.12. we can iterate thresholds after one week to avoid noisy blocks.

kevin: noted — i'll open a small RFC and a PR for the gating check. linking checklist: data snapshot id 2026-03-20-ksnap, model artifacts: art://ptq-v3-244555, previous: art://ptq-v2-244480.

sam: micro-experiment results: disabling bias_correction produced ~0.5pt improvement vs v3 baseline but didn't fully recover to v2. disabling kv_pack recovers ~6.8 pts and matches v2. so kv_pack looks like the main culprit. full logs attached.

sylvia: that's pretty decisive. action: revert kv_pack for now, keep other ptq optimizations, re-run nightly. also backfill a test-case in the eval harness where we assert no >5pt drop for any KBQA bucket.

deploy-bot: canary config updated: kv_pack=false for model://redwood/gptx-7b-ptq-v3-canary. Canary will restart with 5% traffic in 10m for validation.

anita: follow-ups:
- eng-ml: ship 2x2 micro-experiments + token-diff tooling (owner: kevin) — due EOD
- infra: keep canary at 0% until micro-experiments finish, then restart at 5% (owner: deploy team) — in flight
- product/QA: add gating thresholds and KBQA smoke cases to promotion pipeline (owner: anita) — due +3d
- docs: mark kv_pack as experimental and note known failure modes (owner: sylvia) — due +5d

sam: thanks all. summary for on-call: KV-packing in PTQ caused large KBQA hallucinations in canary; immediate rollback done; plan = isolate kv_pack interactions, add gating, reinstate canary at 5% after validation. will post final postmortem if anything else comes up. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: postmortem ticket created: PM-2026-0452 (eng-ml)

deploy-bot: staging rollback succeeded. canary traffic now 0% as of 2445556720.

anita: closing loop — keep thread updated, but no further promo until we have A/B results and gating in place.

kevin: I'll open the PRs and tag y'all.

sam: closing thread for now.
